detail.longDescription: I a trying to connect to an s3 bucket from snowflake. I tried everything in the documentation but still get the error: Error assuming AWS_ROLE: User: arn:aws:iam::998493219094:user/96d42000-s is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::272175291647:role/snowflake-s3-role Here is my staging SQL and the permission policy and trust policy { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": [ "s3:GetObject", "s3:GetObjectVersion" ], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::zomato-pipeline-alan/*" }, { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": [ "s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation" ], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::zomato-pipeline-alan" } ] } { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Sid": "", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::998493219094:user/96d42000-s" }, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "sts:ExternalId": "OH46159_SFCRole=2_tHiHZDxc/BO+ICv3tUFLk227iVc=" } } } ] } -- <BUCKET> = your bucket, e.g. zomato-dl-yourname CREATE OR REPLACE STORAGE INTEGRATION ZOMATO_S3_INT TYPE = EXTERNAL_STAGE STORAGE_PROVIDER = 'S3' ENABLED = TRUE STORAGE_AWS_ROLE_ARN = 'arn:aws:iam::272175291647:role/snowflake-s3-role' STORAGE_ALLOWED_LOCATIONS = ('s3://zomato-pipeline-alan/'); CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE ZOMATO.RAW.ZOMATO_RAW_STAGE STORAGE_INTEGRATION = ZOMATO_S3_INT URL = 's3://zomato-pipeline-alan/raw/' FILE_FORMAT = ZOMATO.RAW.CSV_FMT; -- Confirm Snowflake can see your files (should list the seven table folders). LIST @ZOMATO.RAW.ZOMATO_RAW_STAGE;
